summary_rationale: IHCL has structurally transformed from an over-leveraged, asset-heavy hotelier (FY12–FY18 losses, 4% ROCE) into a net-cash hospitality compounder (₹4,345 Cr gross cash, 17.1% ROCE, 33% OPM, 98%–100% CFO/EBITDA conversion, -37 working capital days) anchored by irreplaceable Taj luxury icons (~69% enterprise revenue), a 10M+ Tata Neu loyalty moat (>40% enterprise revenue), and a 93% asset-light pipeline (₹685 Cr management fees growing 22%–30% YoY). All six leading KPIs are in PASS territory through Q2 FY27 (18th consecutive record quarter, +25% domestic LFL RevPAR), though inherent hospitality cyclicality, 82% metro occupancy ceilings, and the ₹3,600 Cr capex cycle (Taj Bandstand/SeaRock) require ongoing discipline.
